hero.title_main: The working-time register the law asks of you,
hero.title_gradient: and nothing you do not need
hero.subtitle: Every employer has to record what their staff work. Coaster does that for any business, and adds orders and inventory if you run a bar or a shop. Nothing else.

modules.title: Turn on what you use
modules.subtitle: You choose what you need when you create your establishment. What you leave off never appears — not in the menu, not in the app.
modules.time_tracking_desc: Clocking and the rota. An unalterable register, corrections that leave a trace, and a CSV export for a labour inspection. Always on, because it is a legal obligation.
modules.orders_desc: Tables, orders and payments line by line. Cash, card or split, with tips and discounts, and the ticket printed at the counter or in the kitchen.
modules.inventory_desc: A catalogue with photos, stock at a glance and a warning when something runs low. Start from a ready-made catalogue or build your own.

how.title: Three steps and you are in
how.step1_desc: Sign in with Google and give it a name. No card needed.
how.step2_desc: Bar, shop or office. We turn on the modules that fit, and you can change them whenever you like.
how.step3_desc: Everyone clocks in from their phone and you see the real day against the rota.

pricing.title: No surprises
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Move up when you need to.
pricing.free_desc: To get going and keep the working-time register.
pricing.free_feature2: Full time tracking and CSV export
pricing.pro_desc: For when the volume stops fitting the free plan.
pricing.note: No lock-in. If you stop paying you keep access to your history.
